note: Everything in this file is public on purpose: the vault id, the lane's append token and the recipient's public key. The append token can only write; it cannot list, fetch or read anything. The recipient is subscribe@sgit.ai, whose private keys live, passphrase-encrypted, in the subscribe vault itself, so the one secret is that vault's key, which is not on this site. The same identity is in /.well-known/sgit-agents.json. Recompute the fingerprint from the PEM before trusting it.

lane.name: subscribe
lane.use: one single-part .eml per subscribe request, encrypted to encrypt_to in the visitor's browser, unsigned, X-EmailFS-Kind notification, X-SGit-Form subscribe
